scope: Signed floating resolution-unit property through actual selector, scalar addition and final packing
limits: The test uses actual bound-format resolution, scalar toward-zero addition and depth packing. It does not execute geometry/rasterization or native images.
Input depths are within the vertex maximum and shifts exclude endpoint saturation. Finite sampled values across every exponent are not exhaustive over every mantissa.
The separately running176-check composition remains necessary. No full precision, G04/H6/H0-H8 or PPA closure.
archive_scope_note: Historical branch evidence retained during main integration; this does not qualify current main inputs.
